summary: Closed the caller side of the exactly-once chain: both proposal entry points document that a timed-out proposal is retried without updating the session and that the session is advanced only after success, the Chinese overview states the same rule, and ProposalCompleted panics unless the series is exactly one ahead of the acknowledged value while the pre-proposal validity check permits reusing the same series. So a contract-following client retries under the same series and the server's stored-result path applies the command at most once. Recorded one knowledge entry and an explained, refuted account, noting that the rule is a caller duty a misuse cannot be detected server-side. No execution requested.
